concept.title: Identity and encryption
concept.shortdesc: A profile is a key pair that lives on the phone. Cards and content are signed with it, and private messages are sealed to the recipient with libsodium.

ul.li: Finishing setup generates 12 BIP39 recovery words. The words derive an Ed25519 key pair, and the user ID is a BLAKE2b hash derived from it.
The date of birth is stored only on the phone. Other phones receive the age, or an age band (18 to 24, 25 to 34, 35 to 44, 45+) when Show my age is off.
The recovery words are kept in the iOS keychain, which survives deleting the app. Only Delete my profile removes them.

table.title: What protects each kind of data

row.entry: Signed with Ed25519, so a phone can verify who wrote them.
Sealed to the recipient with crypto_box_seal (X25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305).
Encrypted with crypto_secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305), then sealed to the recipient.
Multipeer Connectivity link encryption, which the app requires on every session.
